# Burlington HVAC Pros

> From its base in Burlington, Halton Region, Burlington HVAC Pros serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 637-4218  |  Email: contact@burlingtonhvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://burlingtonhvacpros.ca

Service areas: Burlington, Oakville, Milton, Georgetown, Acton, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby
